CustomField.description: Debt service coverage ratio: net operating income over annual debt service, as a multiple (1.25 means 1.25x). LOS-DSCR-001 requires at least 1.25x; the approved exception LOS-DSCR-002 allows 1.15x with a cash reserve. Below that is a Credit Risk decision.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: NOI over annual debt service, as a multiple. Policy minimum 1.25x (LOS-DSCR-001).
CustomField.label: Debt Service Coverage
